purpose: Replace the first 100 remaining generic Career OPEN_CATEGORY_MEMBER_OR_QUANTIFIER_UNSPECIFIED blockers with precise source/canonical semantic blockers without manufacturing category membership or activation defaults.

evidence_catalog.finding: 煞曜 has source-explicit closed six-malefic membership; 事业宫 scoped 煞 is an alias to that category. Membership closure does not choose ANY/ALL/N_OF.
吉曜 is OPEN_VALENCE_CATEGORY; it is not silently replaced by a fixed favorable-star list.
桃花/桃花诸曜 remain OPEN_FUNCTIONAL_CATEGORY; no global closed membership is authorized.
煞忌、刑耗、煞耗、煞刑诸曜 are source-compound/open-composition surfaces; internal AND/OR and open members must be preserved as unresolved.
吉化 has closed favorable-transformation membership; 吉化吉曜 remains a source compound with an open 吉曜 component.
羊陀 is a source-explicit pair shorthand; pair membership is closed while activation realization remains contextual.
辅佐诸曜 has closed auxiliary-eight membership; 辅佐吉曜 has a closed base with a contextual favorable qualifier.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 太阳守事业宫，吉则事业广大，声名鼎盛；凶则事业空虚，浮夸不实。丑未宫太阴太阳同度，吉则名利双收，凶则仅虚名虚利。
evidence_catalog.finding: Plain 吉/凶 here function as configuration-valence predicates, not star-member categories; classify as VALENCE_STATE_CRITERION_UNSPECIFIED.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 但若吉煞交集……；倘吉煞交集，则不过中下级行政人员。
evidence_catalog.finding: 吉煞交集 is a mixed-valence composition criterion; the source does not supply a reusable member set or aggregation formula.
三台八座、恩光天贵后有 等杂曜 open-tail marker; the examples cannot be frozen into a closed four-star list.
Source literal is 多见属火的星曜. Both elemental membership and the nonnumeric 多见 threshold remain open.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 卯酉廉破，见煞轻者……；贪狼化权，见煞曜而不多者……
evidence_catalog.finding: 轻 and 不多 are source-explicit qualitative severity/cardinality constraints; no numeric threshold is supplied.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 但若见煞、天姚、天刑、大耗、劫煞等杂曜，则易由偏门或半偏行业起家。
evidence_catalog.finding: CA03-298 projection omitted the source open-tail marker 等杂曜; restore it and keep membership/list activation open.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 贪狼与吉化、吉曜会合者，又见三台八座、台辅封诰、天官天福、恩光天贵等吉曜者，亦可从政。
evidence_catalog.finding: CA07-633 source gives named examples plus 等吉曜; projection `多辅曜` creates a cardinality concept not stated by the source.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 寅申宫贪狼与廉贞相对，最不宜陀罗同度。见煞(火铃亦然)，主为政贪墨……
evidence_catalog.finding: CA07-652 source contains sequential clauses, not `陀罗 OR 煞`; branch scope must be rechecked rather than normalized by invented OR.

evidence_catalog.excerpt: 天相与空劫同度，吉则可以凭意念打出天下……若无吉曜，或且见凶星恶曜者……
evidence_catalog.finding: CA08-725 positive condition is the valence predicate 吉; the later negative clause does not license `吉 == 有吉曜`.
